column1: # Uniques whose art Exiled Exchange 2's item database lacks, gives as their base's, or which it
# doesn't list at all: the art the trade site's listings of each show (their item's `icon`, fetched
# 2026-10-12), which is the art the game draws -- what the price check recognizes an unidentified
# unique by. The English name, the Russian one (the trade site's) and the art URL's path after
# https://web.poecdn.com/gen/image/, a tab apart; generate_item_refs.py puts the art in place of
# the database's, or adds the unique when the database has no such row.
